اعتمدتم (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَدْتُمْ (iʕtamadtum) /iʕ.ta.mad.tum/: second-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
# اُعْتُمِدْتُمْ (uʕtumidtum) /uʕ.tu.mid.tum/: second-person masculine plural past passive of اِعْتَمَدَ (iʕtamada)
